subject: Training-on-customer-data opt-out confirmation / Data handling follow-up
messages:
From: Jamie Lopez <jamie.lopez@finedge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finedge.com>, security@finedge.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: data handling & training-on-customer-data

Thanks for the call this morning, Soojin — quick recap from the FinEdge side and a couple of asks so we can move forward on the POC:

Key requirements we discussed:
- We must prevent FinEdge customer inputs from being used for model training or improvements (training-on-customer-data opt-out).
- Data residency: all inference logs and any persisted artifacts need to remain in EU-West-1.
- Retention: customer input logs and trace logs retained for max 90 days, then purged unless an incident requires preservation.
- Logging controls: redact PII from logging by default; provide an auditable process for targeted retention if needed.

Next steps we need from Redwood:
1) A written confirmation that FinEdge data will not be used for model improvements and will be excluded from any training corpora.
2) High-level DPA / retention language we can share with procurement and security.
3) SOC 2 summary and any relevant compliance artifacts.

Please include the exact language we can add into our procurement docs (or a DPA addendum). If you prefer, send an invite and we can run this through legal — but would like a short confirmation email first so procurement can unblock the POC.

Thanks,
Jamie Lopez
Senior Product Manager — Data Platform
FinEdge

---

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: data handling & training-on-customer-data

Jamie — thanks for the clear recap and the asks. Appreciate the checklist; here's our immediate response and proposed next steps.

Quick confirmation (summary):
- Redwood will opt FinEdge out of any model training or improvements using customer-provided inputs for the POC and any production traffic under DEAL-2026-0143.
- Data residency: we will use EU-West-1 hosts for all processing and storage for this account; we'll include region locking in the DPA.
- Retention: default log retention for request/response traces will be set to 90 days and purged thereafter.
- Logging/PII: our agent SDK includes configurable PII redaction; we'll enable redaction by default for FinEdge. Additional manual redaction workflows can be scoped if you need them.

Attachments going to be useful: SOC 2 summary (high level) and a draft DPA with opt-out language included. I'm attaching a short SOC2_summary.pdf and a DPA draft (DPA_FinEdge_Redwood_v1.pdf) for your review.

Next steps:
1) Marissa (cc'd) from Security will follow up with the DPA addendum language and a short statement that you can attach to procurement.
2) Connor from Legal will prepare a signed confirmation (DocuSign) with the training opt-out clause and the retention commitment.
3) If any of the retention/region constraints need different settings (e.g., 30 / 365 days), let us know now before Connor finalizes language.

I'll schedule a quick 20-min follow-up if that helps.

—
Soojin Lee
Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf, DPA_FinEdge_Redwood_v1.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: data handling & training-on-customer-data

Jamie — looping in a couple of details you can share with procurement/security right away.

Proposed DPA clause (draft language you can paste):
"Redwood Inference will not use Customer Input Data or derived artifacts provided under the POC or under DEAL-2026-0143 for model training, algorithmic improvements, or inclusion in any external corpora. Customer Input Data shall be processed and stored only within the EU-West-1 region for the duration of the Agreement, and shall be retained for a maximum of 90 days, after which Redwood will delete such data except where preservation is required by law or a mutually agreed incident response. Redwood will provide configurable PII redaction at the request of the Customer and maintain audit logs of access to Customer Input Data."

Security artifacts attached: SOC2_summary.pdf (overview) and the DPA draft (DPA_FinEdge_Redwood_v1.pdf). The DPA draft includes a signature block and a short Appendix specifying the opt-out for training-on-customer-data.

If that language looks good, Connor will send a DocuSign envelope you can sign to confirm.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf, DPA_FinEdge_Redwood_v1.pdf

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Lopez <jamie.lopez@finedge.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: data handling & training-on-customer-data (Signed Opt-Out)

Jamie — thanks for the quick turn. Per Marissa and Soojin's notes, we've prepared the formal confirmation and DocuSign envelope. Summary of commitments being executed for DEAL-2026-0143: 

- Training opt-out: Redwood confirms that FinEdge Customer Input Data will NOT be used to train, fine-tune, or improve Redwood models. This includes any automated or manual inclusion in internal training datasets.
- Data residency: All processing and storage for the account will be restricted to the EU-West-1 region (AWS eu-west-1) unless mutually agreed otherwise in writing.
- Retention: Request/response traces, logs, and any derived artifacts will be retained for 90 days by default and then deleted. Incident preservation will be handled via a documented legal hold process; such preservation requires written notice.
- Logging & PII: PII redaction will be enabled by default. Access to raw Customer Input Data is logged and auditable; we will provide access logs upon authorized request as specified in the DPA.

DocuSign envelope: https://app.hellosign.com/s/DocuSignEnvelopeID-12345
Envelope ID: HS-ENVELOPE-2026-6789

If you confirm (sign), we'll countersign and attach the executed DPA to the deal record (HubSpot DEAL-2026-0143). Let us know if you need any small wording tweaks (e.g., retention = 30 days) before signing.

Regards,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Counsel — Privacy & Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: DPA_FinEdge_Redwood_v1.pdf (for reference)
